This pure, white Christmas tree will form the striking centrepiece of your Christmas decorations. Made of quality PVC material, it looks like a real Christmas tree. Featuring energy-efficient LED lights, it lights up beautifully and creates a cosy holiday atmosphere. What's more, decorated with the beautiful peak and balls, this Xmas tree will be eye-catching in your home. Create a unique Christmas atmosphere in your home! Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. cf2ee0nh.sourceDescription: Tuck unsightly tree stands out of the way with our rustic white and gold Christmas tree skirts. Made to complement realistic Christmas trees and white Xmas trees, these wooden Christmas tree skirts provide the perfect foundation for any festive scene. Match with any of our full-width trees between 6ft-8ft in height. Coming in four parts, they’re super easy to assemble; just unfold, place under the tree, and clip together. Simple! Accessories shown in the images are not included with the item. The product is sold without any accessories. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester WN5 8DB
